title: Passage 14
voice: 温暖自然英式女老师｜IndexTTS2.5 慢速教学

sentences.en: Children are known for wanting answers to many questions, because curiosity is part of human nature.
sentences.cn: 众所周知，孩子们渴望得到许多问题的答案，因为好奇心是人类天性的一部分。

sentences.en: They wonder why air cannot be seen.
sentences.cn: 他们想知道为什么空气是看不见的。

sentences.en: They ask why tape can hold different things together.
sentences.cn: 他们会问为什么胶带能把不同的东西粘在一起。

sentences.en: Books and TV shows, including cartoons, often depend on curiosity.
sentences.cn: 书籍和电视节目，包括动画片，往往都离不开好奇心。

sentences.en: People keep reading or watching because they want to find out what happens.
sentences.cn: 人们之所以会继续读下去或者看下去，就是想知道后面会发生什么。

sentences.en: Curiosity provides many advantages.
sentences.cn: 好奇心有很多好处。

sentences.en: If you develop the curiosity of learning, classes will become more interesting.
sentences.cn: 如果你培养了学习的好奇心，课堂就会变得更有趣。

sentences.en: You will be good at them because you enjoy the process of learning.
sentences.cn: 因为你享受学习的过程，所以你会学得很好。

sentences.en: Even if you're no longer a student, curiosity will make you an able worker.
sentences.cn: 即使你不再是学生，好奇心也会让你成为有才干的工作者。

sentences.en: What will you do if you're not yet curious?
sentences.cn: 如果你还没变得好奇，你打算怎么做？

sentences.en: Luckily, curiosity is a skill that can be improved.
sentences.cn: 幸运的是，好奇心是一种可以提升的技能。

sentences.en: Often, the more you learn about a topic, the more interesting it becomes.
sentences.cn: 通常，你对一个话题了解得越多，它就变得越有趣。

sentences.en: To improve your curiosity, get information from as many sources as possible when you learn about a topic.
sentences.cn: 为了增强你的好奇心，在学习一个主题时，从尽可能多的来源去获取信息。

sentences.en: At the same time, read all kinds of books, watch or listen to speeches, and ask questions.
sentences.cn: 同时，阅读各种书籍，观看或聆听演讲，并且提问。

sentences.en: Don't always get information in the same way.
sentences.cn: 不要总是以同样的方式获取信息。

sentences.en: Instead, learn to understand the facts that different people know.
sentences.cn: 相反，要学会去了解不同的人所知道的情况。

sentences.en: Don't assume you already know everything.
sentences.cn: 不要以为你已经知道了一切。

sentences.en: Instead, search for other possibilities and opinions.
sentences.cn: 相反，要寻找其他的可能性和观点。

sentences.en: Learning to paint can promote your creativity.
sentences.cn: 学习绘画可以提升你的创造力。

sentences.en: Walking around your hometown or playing basketball at the playground on the weekend provides opportunities to ask and answer questions.
sentences.cn: 周末在家乡四处走走或在操场打篮球，都能为你提供提问和回答问题的机会。

sentences.en: Listening to an opera or visiting the market allows you to explore.
sentences.cn: 听歌剧或逛市场也是探索的机会。

sentences.en: And even a great ad on TV can inspire you.
sentences.cn: 甚至电视上一则精彩的广告也能激发你的灵感。

sentences.en: All these let you learn something, and other people are often happy to share their knowledge.
sentences.cn: 所有这些让你能够学到些东西，而其他人通常也乐于分享他们的知识。

sentences.en: Let's try to become people who are full of curiosity.
sentences.cn: 让我们努力成为一个充满好奇心的人吧。
